items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: I played with Jeff and I played with Johnny Riddick, man.

ctx.x: That's right. You know Tony, yeah, sure. You know, like Jack Riddick called Fuser-Loyal. Fuser-Loyal. Or Tony Fugero-Close. Yeah. Yeah, man. I played with Jeff and I played with Johnny Riddick, man. Where did you play with Johnny? Where? Where? Was he here in the city? In Mobile. Oh, you went over to Mobile? It's a spot job, you know. Oh, yeah? I played with Harry Torres, you know. I played so many bands, you know. And that's the expanded. One of us more. Who's that same? Did you hear that thing? No. I had Sam…
I'm doing a lot of stuff. I'm doing a lot of stuff.
